renderedExposure.domain: Rendered encoded sRGB D65 -> EOTF linear sRGB -> 2^EV -> OETF -> per-channel clip[0,1]
renderedExposure.firstObservedNewIrreversibleLoss: Final per-channel clamp after encoded-preclip; previous input clipping not recoverable

basicTone.domain: Encoded-sRGB float tool node; linear-luma bend/shoulder then EncodeGamut max normalization
basicTone.difference: The exposure subterm atEV0 is identity with other adjustments at defaults; full BasicTone has other controls. PositiveEV rational luma mapping and EncodeGamut are not MaxChannelShoulderV1.

professionalRaw.domain: LibRaw linear ProPhoto D65 uint16 -> float master -> matrix to linear sRGB -> luma exponential shoulder -> neutral-axis gamut compression -> OETF
professionalRaw.irreversibleStages: LibRaw uint16 clipping already in contract; later gamut compression/chroma neutralization and float rounding are separate

proposalAPlacement: Proposed only: rendered-input EOTF -> existing exposure gain -> optional new versioned highlight stage -> original OETF/clip; never appended after existing clip
notConflated: neutral gamut compression vs hue discontinuity
native P6 reproducibility vs rendered-file/wholeApp acceptance
